{{Quote|I would offer you the warning to not approach the area we are herding these Rebels to. The stormtroopers there have orders of shoot to kill.|An Imperial major, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:aIM">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|an Imperial Major|Rori}}</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Encampment''', also known as the '''Imperial Military Base''', was a sizable [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] installation on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
Located some distance south of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]], the Imperial Encampment was a fortified Imperial stronghold. It consisted of a large main building, three smaller outpost buildings, and multiple watch towers. It was staffed by a couple [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]] and many [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]]. Some of the more specialized [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] staffing the base included [[Stormtrooper sniper/Legends|stormtrooper snipers]] and [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]].<ref name="SWG:IE" />

==History==
{{Quote|This declaration concerns all Rebels and sympathizers to the Rebel cause. The Empire has chosen to end it's'' [sic] ''war with Rebellion. The Empire is offering amnesty to all Rebels, and has set a meeting location for peace negotiations. Are you interested in peace with the Empire?|An Imperial major, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:aIM" />}}
[[File:ImperialEncampmentInterior.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Dark troopers securing the Imperial Encampment's main building.]]
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], an Imperial [[Major/Legends|major]] in Narmle attempted to trick members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to visit this base, under the pretense of peace negotiations. In fact, he had ordered the stormtroopers to shoot and [[Death/Legends|kill]] any visitors.<ref name="SWG:aIM" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Imperial Encampment had become a contested hotspot in the Galactic Civil War and Imperial and Rebel forces fought several times for the control of the base. Rebel forces managed to capture the camp several times but Imperial forces had always taken it back.<ref name="StW" /> Around the same time, a spacer managed to infiltrate the Imperial Encampment and stole a piece of [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]].<ref name="SWG:LISTA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Lost Imperial Stormtrooper Armor}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Encampment was a location in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG:IE" /> prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Players who visited the encampment were awarded with an exploration badge.<ref name="SWG:IE" /> With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update on [[August 3]], 2003,<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref> the Imperial Encampment was turned into a "Factional NPC Base". Groups of Rebel players could attack Imperial NPCs and achieve several objectives to take control of the base.<ref name="StW" />
